lore_anchors.definition: A high-grade demonic cultivation technique that requires a blood sacrifice of numerous powerful cultivator souls to begin cultivation.
A forbidden Ghost Spirit Sect formation that can refine a cultivator’s physical body into energy, leaving only their soul intact.
In traditional Chinese marriage customs, a significant gift from the groom’s family to the bride’s family, symbolizing the formalizing of the union.
A ritualistic vow that binds two parties in a life-and-death covenant, often used in arranged marriages within the cultivation world.
